items.title: Tensoring an injective module by a finite locally free module yields an injective module
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the tensor product of an injective O_X-module I with a finite locally free O_X-module E is again injective. The proof uses the adjunction Hom(F, E tensor I) = Hom(F tensor E^vee, I) for the dual E^vee = SheafHom(E, O_X), which is again finite locally free, and then concludes by the standard criterion: since tensoring with a finite locally free sheaf is exact, the functor Hom(-, E tensor I) is exact and hence E tensor I is injective (proof lines 13827-13839). H2: the adjunction identification with the dual, combined with exactness of tensoring by a finite locally free sheaf, is the whole content, and neither step is a citation-only reduction.
